learning_outcomes.text: Discover the main features of mechanisms.
Synthesize mechanisms' features through a proper choice of their structure and metrics.

syllabus_topics: Kinematics of leverage, cam and gear mechanisms
Theory of gear mechanisms with involuted gear wheels
Balancing of flat leverage mechanisms and rotors
assessment_rules: The process of acquisition is controlled through a test and problem solving tasks. The grades of the test and tasks are combined to form the continuous assessment grade. The assessment type is continuous, with a written and oral exam.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
